advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Update `test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py`'s structural guard to scan the whole `jira_datacenter/` package (or at least `_base.py`, `_issues.py`, `_links.py`, `_hierarchy.py`) instead of only `transport.py`, so the bug-9263 unpaginated-caller guard covers the code that was moved.
evidence: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py:155: `tree = ast.parse(src if src is not None else _TRANSPORT_SRC.read_text())`

_base.py:145 `"_paged_search", jql, lambda offset=start_at: self._client.search_issues(...)` and _issues.py:123 `self._client.search_issues(jql, startAt=start_at, maxResults=max_results)` — the only `search_issues` calls, both now OUTSIDE transport.py
The guard `_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default()` scans `transport.py`, which after this diff has no `search_issues` call (transport.py:1-230 confirmed) — so it can never report an offender.
Ticket AC states 'No test assertion is edited', which prevented the guard's source-file target from being updated to cover the new mixin files.
advisory.finding: The split moves every `search_issues` call site (the `search_issues` method into `_issues.py`, the `_paged_search` pager into `_base.py`) out of `transport.py`, but the structural regression guard `test_no_search_issues_call_relies_on_the_default_page_size` still AST-scans only `transport.py` via `_TRANSPORT_SRC`. That file now contains zero `search_issues` calls, so the guard is vacuously green and no longer protects any live code — bug-9263's protection against a fourth unpaginated whole-project reader is silently defeated.
scenarios: A future contributor adds a bare `self.search_issues(jql)` (default max_results=50) to `_issues.py`/`_links.py`/`_base.py`; the guard that exists to catch exactly this silently passes and the whole-project read truncates past 50 issues.
advisory.suggested_fix: Replace the single `_TRANSPORT_SRC` scan with an iteration over the mixin/base modules that now hold `search_issues` calls (e.g. glob `_*.py` in the package dir plus `transport.py`), running `_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default` on each and aggregating offenders.
